summary: A library drops a staff-selected web directory when it confines children's research too tightly.
realLife: Westerville ended its Library Channel after several years because its list limited what children could reach and the system had technical problems.
inGame: needs: approved directory and reported failures.

turns.pulledBy: A child's topic falls outside the directory.
turns.what: A librarian records the missing subject.
turns.writesBack: Staff have an example for the review.

turns.pulledBy: The board ends the directory restriction.
turns.what: Staff change the children's starting page.
turns.writesBack: A child can look beyond the old list.
